welcome: The foundation for more connected care.
welcomeCopy: This first delivery establishes the visual structure, navigation, internationalization, and routes that VitaLink will build on.
serviceNotice: Clinical functionality will be introduced progressively in later increments.
professionalCopy: Open the workspace prepared for future clinical tools.
familyCopy: Open the workspace prepared for family follow-up.
older-adultCopy: Open a simple experience prepared for the older adult.
foundationCopy: The foundation separates navigation, presentation, translations, and routes so future functionality can be added without rebuilding the application.
workspaceFoundationCopy: This workspace already has navigation, language, routes, and visual structure. Role-specific functionality will be added in later increments.
foundationReadyCopy: The application loads correctly and this user workspace already has a stable route.
nextStepsCopy: Role-specific functionality will be connected here without changing the main structure.
securityBaseCopy: The interface is ready to integrate authentication, permissions, and real data in later increments.
preferencesFoundationCopy: The preferences route is part of the base navigation and is ready to receive its controls.
preferencesReadyCopy: Real preference controls will be introduced in a later increment.
termsCopy: This version is an academic and prototyping foundation for VitaLink. Clinical and production features will be implemented progressively.
termsStorage: Real data, permissions, and external communications are not part of this delivery yet.
notFoundCopy: The requested route does not exist in this version of the application.
